overview.match: Gordon supported diversity, equity and inclusion
overview.text: Gordon has said voting by mail is a secure option governed by state law and subject to multiple checks. She urged voters to return mail ballots early or use secure drop boxes at early voting locations. Her office counters misinformation through a website it calls a 'trusted source.' When nominated, she pledged to improve online access to records, potentially use AI for customer service, and improve language access at polling places. She created the clerk's office's first deputy clerk for diversity, equity and inclusion, saying federal policies had pushed immigrant families and same-sex couples to seek birth certificates and marriage licenses. She is working with the Cook County Sheriff to ensure polling places remain safe.
